item.title: Green Island UFSD superintendent hired by Coxsackie-Athens CSD
item.description: The Coxsackie-Athens Central School District will soon welcome a new superintendent to the district. According to the district board of education, Daniel Kalbfliesh, the current Superintendent at Green Island Union Free School District, will start the position on July 1.

item.title: RANKED: Best places to live in the Capital Region for 2026

item.title: HVCC to highlight girls in STEM event with annual event
